purpose: Provide deterministic prebuild budgets for T12 static validators and synthetic progression-query reference tooling. These are not substitutes for post-activation C6 shipping measurements.

static_validation_budget.input_shape: 100-level synthetic progression + 10 milestones + 14 static preparation checks: progression, matrix, shipping schema, runtime interface, traceability, downstream contract, candidate evidence, critic records, evidence index, engine oracle, blank binding guard, cross-contract consistency, upstream-binding consistency, and defect-ledger consistency
static_validation_budget.measurement_rule: Timing is measured without tracemalloc instrumentation. Retained/peak traced memory is measured in a separate bounded pass so allocation tracing overhead is not mistaken for validator latency.

must_measure: integrated frame-time/draw-call/primitive impact where presentation exists
shipping_c6_boundary.rule: Prebuild Python timings cannot approve or waive shipping C6. Shipping thresholds must be measured on the accepted T12 candidate/integrated artifact using the production engine evidence pipeline.
